title: Pack Retrieved Chunks into a Token Budget
hints: A chunk's cost is the tokens of its whole rendered block, wrapper tags included. The model pays for the tags too.
Dedupe first, in (-score, chunk_id) order, comparing lowercase token sets with Jaccard against every chunk you have kept so far.

Select by score per token, and don't stop at the first chunk that doesn't fit: a smaller one later may still fit. Finally, group the chosen chunks by doc and put each doc's chunks back in reading order.
